entities.summary: Robert of St Albansα was an English Templar Knight who converted to Islam from Christianity in 1185. In 1187, he led an army for Saladin against the Crusaders during the Battle of Hattin as well as the reconquest of Jerusalem, which was at the time under the control of the Franks.
